spans.s: €6P. (गिलति, गिलित) To swallow; (properly speaking, this is not a separate root, but is connected with गॄ).

a. [गिल्-क] Who or what swallows or devours; e. g. तिमिङ्गिलगिलोऽप्यस्ति तद्गिलोप्यस्ति राघवः; see तिमिङ्गिल. 
-लः 
__1 The citron tree. 
__2 A crocodile in the Ganges. 
-Comp. 
-गिलः, -ग्राहः a crocodile, shark.

गिलनम्,
गिलिः f. Swallowing, eating up.
A hard tumour in the throat.
